pol-ins-01-c1.text: Max Weber (translated extract) (1919). Politics as a Vocation (extract). Balliol College, University of Oxford.
pol-ins-01-c1.quote: Today, however, we have to say that a state is a human community that (successfully) claims the monopoly of the legitimate use of physical force within a given territory.
pol-ins-01-c1.claim: A state, he said, is a 'human community that (successfully) claims the monopoly of the legitimate use of physical force within a given territory.'

pol-ins-01-c2.text: Daniel Philpott (2003). Sovereignty. Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy.
pol-ins-01-c2.quote: Nowhere in the settlement's treaties is a sovereign states system or even the state as the reigning legitimate unit, prescribed.
pol-ins-01-c2.claim: The actual treaty texts say less about sovereignty than the standard 'Westphalian' narrative suggests
